name: search_finds_running
why: a running session must be findable by search

name: search_finds_ended
why: the flagship claim: findable AFTER it ends, or track-and-control is a lie

name: adopt_ghost_not_live
why: adopting a non-existent remote session must report NOT live

name: drive_dead_refuses
why: driving a session that does not exist must fail, never silently succeed

name: honest_liveness_adversary
why: the false-green class: a claim of live must be earned, not assumed

name: manager_worker_greenmark
why: the nested-manager pattern must work end-to-end: a manager session spawns a worker that leaves a harmless green mark, with the manager->worker edge first-class in the registry

name: visible_manager_worker
why: real-surface proof: the nested-manager pattern must be VISIBLE — manager and worker each in a real iTerm2 window on this mac, verified against the real window manager, not a mock. macOS/iTerm2 only; EMUX_CTC_HOLD=N to watch
